archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Architectural Luxury

headings.styling: tracking-tight, uppercase for tags with tracking-[0.2em]

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, py-24. Never cramp elements.
layouts.grid: Bento 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for featured installations. Asymmetrical grids for technology sections.
layouts.alignment: Strictly left-aligned text for architectural precision. Only center when explicitly required for visual balance.
layouts.borders: 1px solid border-white/10. Grid borders for technical sections. Exposed skeleton layout.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: The 'Grid Borders' look for technical specs. 'Glassmorphism (Crystal)' for floating headers and menus.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-5%) to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on borders and background contrast for depth.

motion.animations: Framer Motion. Slow, deliberate reveals. Fade-up with slight Y translation (y: 20, duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]).
motion.interactions: Hover states on cards should brighten the border (border-white/30) and slightly scale imagery (1.02).

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Text over images MUST have a gradient overlay or background blur.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.

hero_bg.description: Dubai skyline, used as a dark tinted background for the hero section.

led_close_up.description: Close up of LED technology, for 'Core Technology' section.

outdoor_display.description: Large outdoor building LED display, for 'Featured Installations'.

transparent_glass.description: Transparent smart glass architecture, for 'GlassMorph' product category.

control_room.description: High-tech control room, for 'Industries / Applications' section.

media.hero_overlay: bg-black/60 to bg-black/80 gradient to ensure H1 contrast.
media.treatment: Images should be desaturated slightly or have a cool tint to fit the architectural vibe. Never use flat blanket overlays that kill the image completely; use gradients.

content_hierarchy.h1: LED Display & Digital Signage Solutions for UAE & GCC
content_hierarchy.description: Design, supply, engineering, installation and lifecycle support for premium LED displays, digital signage, MicroLED, transparent displays and immersive visual systems.

content_hierarchy.content: Logos of top GCC clients and quick stats (e.g., '500+ GCC Installations'). Stat counters must render final values in semantic HTML first.
Interactive or grid-based selector for visitor needs (Retail, Corporate, Control Room, Architecture).
Project-led visual storytelling cards. Includes: Project/Location, Industry, Technology, Result, and 'View Project' CTA. Real imagery only.

Focus on clarity before brand names: Fine-Pitch & MicroLED (LumiMorph), Architectural Displays (NaturaTex), Interactive Signage (SignaTouch), Transparent LED (GlassMorph), Professional LED (PixelVue).
Grid-based list of engineering advantages and GCC-specific expertise.
Showcasing where the tech is used (e.g., control rooms, luxury retail).
Dedicated portal link for professionals. Highlight '24/7 Virtual Showroom'.
Software & management aspect of the displays.
Final CTA and comprehensive footer with dark contrast.

technical_constraints.seo: Homepage must remain SEO-regression clean. One H1 only. Initial HTML must contain final hero content.
technical_constraints.architecture: Preserve existing CRA + CRACO static prerender architecture. Do not change routing or frameworks.
technical_constraints.counters: Final values MUST be present in semantic HTML. Do not expose 0 to crawlers.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Solid dark colors look premium.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use modern button styles (sharp geometric shapes for this architectural brand, NOT pill-shaped).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and crisp 1px borders separate good from extraordinary.
Never use placeholder text for images or logos.
